market_question: Will Keisha Lance Bottoms win the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic primary election?
reasoning: Keisha Lance Bottoms is an early front‐runner but has not officially declared her candidacy for a primary more than a year away. Her recent electoral history (declining to seek re‐election as Atlanta mayor) and the open nature of the seat make a crowded field likely, so the market’s 94.7% implied probability heavily overstates her certainty of winning.
evidence_points: Bottoms has not yet announced a 2026 run; candidacy is only speculative.
Her 2021 decision not to run for re‐election signaled lower electoral confidence.
Other prominent Georgia Democrats (e.g., Jason Carter, Stacey Abrams allies) could enter the primary.
No Democratic incumbent sits in the governor’s office, historically leading to competitive primaries.
